summary.headline: Codex 13: Military Questions
summary.text: Codex 13 catalog entry lists astrological material on the seven stars in the decans of the twelve signs, questions concerning war, expeditions, ambushes, deceit, besieged cities, and fixing a tent, plus a chapter on inceptions. It identifies the Florentine manuscript as Plut. 28, cod. 36, notes its fifteenth-century format and 102 folios, and records its ending in Apomasaris’s Book II, chapter 73, on Zeus ruling a nativity.
